name: Adagia
description: Adagia, also called the world of mirrors, is a windy terrestrial planet orbiting the supervoid Sothera in the Edge and the main base of the Sunstar Free Company.

bio.text: The Sunstar Free Company settled Adagia and declared itself the administrator of the world.

bio.text: It then encased the world in mirrored superstructures to reflect extra light.

bio.text: Stories also describe it as a Summist colony under mirrorscapes and as the home world of Geldan, who picked native flowers there as a child.
